about: SAP Business One Service Layer calls for OneRecord Phase 2 (automatic creation after MDM approval). OData v4 endpoints (/b1s/v2). Replace <b1-server> with the Service Layer host. All business data is fictional.
assumptions: SAP Business One 10.0 FP 2405 or later, on Microsoft SQL Server or SAP HANA
One dedicated integration user; credentials held in Azure Key Vault, never in the flow
UDF U_OneRecordRef exists on OCRD, OITM and OPRC to carry the OneRecord request ID
Codes follow the OneRecord numbering convention and are assigned before the call

requests.name: Login
requests.notes: Every later call sends both cookies. The session expires after 30 minutes idle (configurable in b1s.conf), so log in per flow run and log out at the end.

requests.name: Create item (REQ-1042)

body.ForeignName: Dengue IgG/IgM Combo Rapid Test, 30 tests

requests.notes: Batch management is on because reagent lot and expiry traceability is required. ItemCode is the key; the smallest valid payload is ItemCode, ItemName and ItemType.

requests.name: Create customer business partner
requests.notes: Payment terms and credit limit come from the Restricted list and are only ever read by the integration user. CardType values: cCustomer, cSupplier, cLid.

requests.name: Create vendor with bank account
requests.notes: BankCode must already exist in B1 (Banks table). The account number shown here is fictional.

requests.name: Create cost centre (profit centre)
requests.notes: CenterCode is limited to 8 characters (OPRC.PrcCode) and CenterName to 30. The OneRecord display code CC-SG-0031 is posted as SG-0031; see README. Dimension design: 1 = Country, 2 = Business unit, 3 = Department.

requests.name: Extend existing customer (add a ship-to address)
requests.notes: PATCH merges collections by default: the new address is added and existing ones are kept. Used for the 'Extend existing record' request type.

requests.name: Create business partner atomically with $batch
requests.body:
--batch_or1051
Content-Type: multipart/mixed;boundary=changeset_or1051

--changeset_or1051
Content-Type: application/http
Content-Transfer-Encoding: binary
Content-ID: 1

POST /b1s/v2/BusinessPartners
Content-Type: application/json

{"CardCode":"C-SG-00123","CardName":"Harbourfront Specialist Clinic Pte Ltd","CardType":"cCustomer","Currency":"SGD","U_OneRecordRef":"REQ-1051"}

--changeset_or1051
Content-Type: application/http
Content-Transfer-Encoding: binary
Content-ID: 2

PATCH /b1s/v2/BusinessPartners('C-SG-00123')
Content-Type: application/json

{"BPAddresses":[{"AddressName":"BILL TO","AddressType":"bo_BillTo","Street":"1 Maritime Square #09-12","ZipCode":"099253","Country":"SG"}]}

--changeset_or1051--
--batch_or1051--
requests.notes: All operations inside one changeset commit or roll back together, so a failed address never leaves a half-created partner.

requests.name: Logout
requests.notes: Always log out in the flow's Finally scope so integration sessions don't pile up.
